title: Average income of small-scale food producers, by sex and indigenous status
national_indicator_available: National data are currently unavailable for this indicator.
national_indicator_description: As noted in the [Forward Looking Joint Sector Review Report for Fiscal Year 2023/2024](https://www.minagri.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Minagri/Publications/Annual_Reports/MINAGRI_-_JSR_Report_for_2023-24_FY.pdf), this indicator is among the SDG indicators not currently monitored by the Ministry of Agriculture and Animal Resources. However, relevant information may be found in the [Integrated Household Living Conditions Survey (EICV)](https://statistics.gov.rw/data-sources/surveys/EICV) and [Seasonal Agricultural Survey](https://statistics.gov.rw/data-sources/surveys/Seasonal-Agricultural-Survey) conducted by the National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR).
indicator_definition: SDG indicator 2.3.2 measures income from on-farm production activities, which is related to the production of food and agricultural products. This includes income from crop production, livestock production, fisheries and aquaculture production, and from forestry production. The indicator is computed as annual income.
